fixes.explanation: That's it, baker. Paul says God, intending to show His wrath and make His power known, “…bore with great patience the vessels of His wrath, prepared for destruction?” Then the sentence keeps going in verse 23: “What if He did this to make the riches of His glory known to the vessels of His mercy…” So Paul doesn't stop at wrath. He goes on to the riches of God's glory and the vessels of His mercy (Romans 9:22–23).

problems.problem: The explanation repeats that God bears with the vessels patiently but adds no insight into what Paul is saying.
